messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a change for how SLO thresholds show up in the console. Idea: per-tenant adaptive thresholds plus a notify-routing tier that steps up when monthly quota burn > X%. Want quick alignment before I wire this into the charting/telemetry.
mike: Quick Q — is the adaptive threshold derived from historical p95/p99, or from tenant budget (quota) shape? Those are pretty different signals.
anya: both. baseline = historical p95, but we shift the effective notify threshold down when quota burn is high so alerts surface earlier. the goal is to avoid surprise outages for tenants that hit quota fast.
leah: telemetry note: if we move to a quota-aware notify curve, we need finer-grained burn metrics (per-tenant daily burn, rolling 7d slope). current meter is monthly-aggregate so we'd be blind to fast spikes.
oscar: API implication — console needs to fetch the active notify-policy for a tenant during render. propose adding a lightweight endpoint: GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-policy that returns policy + active_override. minimal contract:

```json
{
  "notify_policy": "tiered",
  "tiers": [
    {"percent": 50, "route": "email"},
    {"percent": 80, "route": "pager"}
  ],
  "quota_override": {"enabled": true, "burn_threshold_pct": 70}
}
```

mike: That looks ok. Two asks: 1) make the endpoint cacheable (stale-while-revalidate) so rendering doesn't add latency; 2) include a reason code when an override is active (e.g., "high_burn", "manual_snooze") so UI can show a tooltip.
anya: agreed on both. we'll also need a telemetry tag so we can backfill evals: notify_policy_source = ["historical","quota_override","manual"].
devex: UX concern — when the console shows threshold shifting because of quota, product folks want a clear banner: "Thresholds temporarily tightened due to high quota consumption" with a CTA to open the rule or request quota. also we should show the projected small-window burn rate.
leah: projection requires more than monthly rollups. I'll spin up a short job to emit per-tenant burn rate metrics at 1h granularity to the telemetry pipeline (safely sampled). That should be cheap and enough for a 24-72h slope.
oscar: rollout plan idea: feature-flag the API + UI change behind a canary that targets 5% of tenants (by volume), and an internal-only switch to route half of internal tenants through the quota-aware policy for testing. We should record both signal quality and false-alert rate.
mike: Ops: need a way to mute canary-generated pages so oncall doesn't get noisy. Maybe a header in the routed alert: X-rc:canary and we map that to a low-priority channel or a separate pager queue.
srebot: [incident-bot] New alert rule created: infra.alerts.notify_policy_validation — will fire if notify-policy endpoint returns 5xx > 1m.
anya: thanks all. Action items: leah — emit 1h burn metrics (ETA 48h). oscar — PR for /v1/tenants/:id/notify-policy and caching headers (ETA 3d). devex — mockups for banner + tooltip (ETA 48h). mike — ops routing for canary alerts (ETA 2d). I'll wire console to call the endpoint behind a FF and add the reason tag. We'll reconvene once metrics start flowing.
devex: tiny nit — please include the effective threshold value in the API so the console doesn't need to recompute client-side (helps consistency + replay).
anya: done — I'll include effective_threshold and effective_reason in the response.
mike: :thumbsup: Good to go. Once canary is live, let's run a 2-week observation where we compare weekly false positives vs baseline and keep a short dashboard for the SLO regressions.
anya: copying this thread into the rollout doc. thanks! :rocket:
